m: नाध् cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. ii, 5) नाधते, occurring only in p. नाधमन, seeking help, asking begging, RV. (cf. नाथ्).

s: f Na nATe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvAMAtmaM-sakaM ESye akaM-sew .) f, ananADat । Na, nADate । nATo davASIrESyArTanAni । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

m: नाधस् n. (prob.) = नाथ, help, refuge, RV. x, 65, 5.
